name: dgx
title: DGX
description: Graphics on displays of SPI, QSPI, 8-bit parallel, parallel RGB, MIPI-DSI and I2C, with its own panel drivers.

rgb.notes: The 16 data lines of RGB565, blue from its lowest bit. The pixel clock is the board's, measured on it: the glass allows a range, the board holds what its PSRAM brings. The frame buffer lies in PSRAM; docs/rgb-display-en.md of DGX says what a program sets: the display made on the core that draws, the other core kept off PSRAM at 33 MHz, CONFIG_SPIRAM_XIP_FROM_PSRAM for a program that writes to the flash, CONFIG_LCD_RGB_RESTART_IN_VSYNC off.

panels.notes: the 7-inch JC8048B070N of the Sunton ESP32-8048S070, with the timing of the demo of its maker; its sheet allows a pixel clock of 29 to 38 MHz

ek9716.notes: An RGB glass takes no commands: pins on the glass set its controller, so DGX describes the glass, not the controller, and another glass is another dgx_rgb_panel_t. The bus turns the picture, by dgx_screen_orientation(). Two frame buffers in PSRAM, 750 KB each at 800x480: a batch of drawing is shown whole, and a moving picture does not tear.

st7701.notes: The 4.3-inch 480x800 glass of the Guition JC4880P443C, with the commands its factory firmware sends; only the MIPI-DSI kind of the controller. It has no calls of its own: dgx_screen_orientation(), dgx_screen_backlight() and dgx_screen_display() turn and switch it. Two frame buffers: one tears a moving picture, and at 24 bits the measure of that board asks for two.

adapter.notes: 0.10.0 is not in the registry. 0.10.8 is the first that builds for the linux target of ESP-IDF: the window of the board host; 0.10.9 turns its glass as the board is held, 0.10.10 gives its mouse, 0.10.11 its keys and a window on no bus. 0.10.12 turns the SSD1306, SSD1309 and SH1106. 0.10.13 draws straight segments by the pen, 0.10.14 a filled circle with a soft edge and gives a screen its user_data. 0.10.16 has the 1.14-inch glass of the ST7789 and the NV3041A at 18 bits, 0.10.17 the SSD1680 of e-paper, whose glue calls dgx_ssd1680_init. 0.11.0 takes the backlight line in the constructor of every display that has one and lights it once the display is set up; it has the 0.96-inch glass of the ST7735. The range starts at 0.10.12: src/ and adapters/ built with it, and with 0.10.17 and 0.11.0, in hello_board on cyd_s028r and jc8012p4a1c on 2026-11-14. 0.11.5 has the ST7701S of the 4.3-inch JC4880P443C, which turns only by dgx_screen_orientation(), the call of every display since 0.11.1. 0.11.6 has the parallel RGB bus and the 7-inch glass of the Sunton ESP32-8048S070. From 0.11.1 every display turns by dgx_screen_orientation() and the glass has a name with DGX_; the glue uses them from there, as 0.12.0 warns at the calls named after a driver and the names without DGX_. 0.12.0 takes the reset line before the resolution in the constructors of the SSD1306, SH1106, SSD1309, SSD1322 and SSD1680.

api.source: include/drivers/, include/bus/ and Kconfig of esp32-component-dgx 0.11.0: every constructor of a display with a backlight takes its line after the reset line, the ST7735 takes a panel and has the 0.96-inch glass of 80x160, reading a display back through its window is gone, which the glue never called; by git diff of the tags 0.10.17 and 0.11.0 on 2026-11-14

history.source: headers of include/ at every tag of esp32-component-dgx: the chips, the buses and the arguments of their init; before tag 0.1.0 nothing is known; 0.10.3 to 0.10.12 by the same headers at each tag on 2026-11-06, 0.10.13 and 0.10.14 on 2026-11-11, 0.10.15 to 0.10.17 on 2026-11-13, 0.11.0 on 2026-11-14
